{{Top}}
A '''poet''' was someone who made up poems.

When in the depths of despair and exhaustion after witnessing [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and confused about his role in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] recalled [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] telling him of a poet he had once read. Though he could no longer recall the exact line from the poet that Kenobi had quoted, he remembered it as being something along the lines of "''there is no greater misery than to remember, with bitter regret, a day when you were happy.''"<ref name="RotSnovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

[[Gender/Legends|Males]] of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Species/Legends|species]] wrote love poems for their spouses during [[Winter/Legends|winters]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sebastin Onyx]] worked as a translator for the mostly illiterate boars such as [[Guth]] to support himself financially.<ref name="Slush">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref> Gamorrean poetry was also read [[Standard day/Legends|nightly]] in [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-style chuba [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] in the [[Mirrsteel Heights]] towers on the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Lords">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
